title: Long-Standing Policy Concession on Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Interest
content:
The reinstatement interest rate on a Term Life Insurance policy is lowered by a long-standing policy concession, set by the policy years the policy had been in force at its lapse date — the whole years from the issue date to the lapse date on record:

- **20 policy years or more** at the lapse date: lowered by 1 percentage point (0.01);
- **10 through 19 policy years**: lowered by half a percentage point (0.005);
- **otherwise**: not lowered.

| Issue date (hypothetical) | Lapse date | Whole years at lapse | Concession |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April 2006 | 2 April 2026 | 20 | 1 percentage point |
| 1 April 2006 | 31 March 2026 | 19 | half a percentage point |
| 1 April 2017 | 2 April 2026 | 9 | none |

Illustration (hypothetical): a rate of 4 percent with a concession of half a point gives 3.5 percent; a rate of 6 percent with a concession of 1 point gives 5 percent.
